title: Handover
description: Change of responsibility or ownership - manufacturer to wholesaler, wholesaler to pharmacy (DSCSA T3 trigger; FMD chain of custody). Who may legitimately appear on either side is answered by the counterparty's entity trust level (OWM-6), not by this schema - see spec Sec.8.2 on Authorized Trading Partner verification.

type.description: Kind of document: purchase order, despatch advice, invoice, bill of lading, other.

items.description: The units handed over, if they are more than the subject of the entry.
